scope: Metadata-only evidence for A82 SCE microdata evaluation truth and recent-B national aggregate evaluation truth. No personal responses or model responses were opened.

time_fields_are_distinct.retrieved_at: When a specific byte-identical source file was downloaded; use a receipt or a SHA-256 match to a receipt that records URL, bytes, and timestamp.
time_fields_are_distinct.published_at: When the source says the observation or release became public; this is not the local download time.
time_fields_are_distinct.historical_version: Evidence that the exact version represents what was published at the relevant historical time. A current/latest microdata snapshot and a local folder date do not establish this.

A82_microdata_evaluation_truth.target_scope: A82 SCE microdata truth construction; artifact scope recorded as evaluation-only.

truth_artifact.timestamp_gap: Truth manifest records hashes and evaluation-only scope but no creation/retrieval timestamp. The 20261023 directory name is not used as a timestamp.

lineage_receipt.note: Receipt records the source paths and exact SHA-256 values used to construct the private labeled reference; those hashes were matched against source download manifests below. No source data contents were read.

matched_source_downloads.historical_version_evidence: Not established by this download manifest; this is a current downloaded file, not a wave-by-wave archived vintage record.
Not established by this download manifest; the file is a later download and does not prove which byte version was public in each survey month.

matched_source_downloads.coverage_label: latest SCE microdata snapshot used by the lineage receipt
matched_source_downloads.copy_lineage_gap: The lineage receipt's path is under a 20261007 directory, but that directory name is not acquisition evidence. The same URL/byte count/SHA appears in two download manifests; the exact copied instance used cannot be distinguished. Both verified retrieval events are retained above.
matched_source_downloads.historical_version_evidence: Not established by the latest-file download; a current snapshot is not a historical as-of vintage.

isolation_claim.evidence: The A82 truth manifest explicitly sets scope to evaluation_only_never_live_input.
isolation_claim.qualification: This record relies on the truth manifest's scope declaration and source lineage metadata; it does not independently audit runtime code or read individual answer rows.

recent_B_aggregate_evaluation_truth.target_scope: Recent-B public national SCE headline evaluation and aggregate readout; no person-level truth.

baseline_archive_ledger.retrieval_time_gap: The ledger says the raw archives were fetched 2026-10-07 but does not record a per-file retrieved_at timestamp. The directory suffix and source_audit_date are not treated as exact file retrieval timestamps.
baseline_archive_ledger.historical_version_evidence: Date-specific NY Fed release URLs, per-record publication dates, and archived-file hashes are present; exact per-file retrieval times are not.

matched_chart_snapshot.evidence_file: docs/sce_source_manifest.json (matching URL/bytes/SHA record); hash also matches docs/sources/sce_baseline_aggregate_sources_latest_20261007.json
matched_chart_snapshot.publication_and_vintage_gap: The download receipt establishes acquisition of these bytes. It does not prove the chart's complete historical revision vintage for each prior target month.

2026_09_official_release_recovery.truth_role: Added official first-release aggregate to evaluation/recovery catalog after the frozen generation package; no forecast regeneration was recorded.

isolation_claim.evidence: The 2026-10-25 recovery metadata says completed_offline_only, new_api_calls=0, and frozen_generation_package_unchanged=true; it identifies the operation as an evaluation recovery.
isolation_claim.qualification: This is an aggregate evaluation-recovery record, not a source-code audit of all B producer paths.

global_gaps: Retrieval timestamps are recorded only where a receipt or exact URL/bytes/SHA match supports them. No directory name, audit date, or file modification time is substituted.
Source publication date and local retrieval time are separate fields; neither alone proves historical vintage validity for a forecast target.
The current/latest SCE microdata snapshots do not establish historically available microdata vintages for each target month.
The A82 derived truth artifact has no recorded artifact creation timestamp in its manifest.
The aggregate archive ledger gives a batch fetch date but not exact retrieved_at timestamps for every archived release page.
